description:
In the popular game Wixoss, there are special cards called LRIGs that few players know about — cards that possess personalities and wills of their own. Ruuko is a teenage girl who just found one of these rare cards. Now, she can use her LRIG to battle in a strange, dark plane of existence. If she wins, her wishes will be granted — but what happens if she loses?

(Source: Funimation)

node.description:
The main character of the anime. Despite having no wish or drive to be an Eternal Girl, and being a complete beginner at the game, she was chosen as a selector. Her reason for battling is simply for the thrill and excitement from it. Ruuko is very caring and thoughtful to the others around her to the point she was willing to lose her battle with Yazuki and Hitoe in order for their wishes to come true. Her LRIG is Tama.

~!At first she does not have any wishes. Later it is revealed that unknowingly she has been wishing to be able to play WIXOSS and battle other Selectors as she takes great joy from it. When the time to make has come though, her final wish was to be able to free the LRIGS from their cards to return them to their normal lives.!~

~!In season 2, Iona replaces Tama as Ruuko's LRIG!~

Ruko's LRIG. Initially, Tama's mannerisms were very much like that of an infant, as she does not actually talk, but communicates in moans and cat-like sounds. After being named, she will also occasionally use her own name as an exclamation. She is energetic, needy, and seems to quickly take a liking to Rūko, despite having been locked in a drawer by her the night after their first encounter. Tama is constantly eager to be used in WIXOSS battles; however, when she actually does fight, her mannerism changes dramatically, and she becomes a fierce warrior, passionately seeking to destroy the enemy. Her power levels seem to be extraordinarily high for the LRIG of a beginner.
~!She was created by Mayu when Mayu first started the Selector Battles. She also is a part of Mayu herself and represents the side of light. Her original name is Shiro.!~

Akira is a model and a Selector. Her LRIG is Piruruku.

Akira has a habit of giving other people short nicknames. Whenever she is fortunate, she says her catchphrase, "Aki-lucky", or "Aki-lovely".

~!After she beat both Hitoe and Yuzuki, she was infuriated by the fact that nothing had changed as she beat two Selectors. Aggravated by this, she threatened to rip Piruruku's card. Piruruku eggs her on, causing Akira to become further annoyed and reveal her wish to bring down Iona.!~

~!After losing to Ruko, she get's provoked into battle by Iona's LRIG, causing her to lose her third battle in a row. After losing to Iona, Akira's wish takes the effect on her, causing her face to get scarred and loosing her place in the studio. For an unknown reason she does not lose any memories of WIXOSS or the other Selectors.!~

Yuzuki goes to middle school with her twin brother Kazuki and friend Ruuko. She befriends Ruuko after seeing her in the canteen with a WIXOSS card. She is very impulsive in battle and tends to commit mistakes because of this behavior.

~!She has feelings for Kazuki Kurebayashi, her twin brother, and to make such relationship possible, she battles in hopes of winning his affections.!~

~!After seeing what happened to Hitoe she desperately wants to win her battles to avoid her wish taking a turn on her like it did on Hitoe.
After challenging several Selectors, she wins her final battle and becomes the Eternal Girl.!~

~!In the last episode, Yuzuki is freed from her card and becomes human again.!~

Iona is a senior student and a fashion model. She and Akira both work in the same modeling agency. Like Akira, she is also a WIXOSS Selector and has the ability to sense what a Selector's wish is. She considers any Selector who doesn't have any wishes as blasphemous and would not waste her time battling against them. Her LRIG card is Urisu.

~!Her wish is to become the LRIG of a powerful Selector. When her wish is granted, she became Ruuko's LRIG, replacing Tama.!~

~!She is one of the first two original LRIGs created by Mayu and also a part of Mayu herself. Her original name given to her by Mayu was Kuro. Later, Ruuko gave her the name Yuki.!~

Piruluk  is the main protagonist of selector infected WIXOSS -peeping analyze- and has a minor role in selector infected WIXOSS. She is the Selector of Remember during the prologue and the first two chapters of selector infected WIXOSS -peeping analyze-.

Hitoe is a shy and timid girl, who's a Selector. Her wish is to have friends.
Her LRIG is Midoriko.

~!Even though they are from different schools, Hitoe eventually becomes friends with Ruuko and Yuzuki, fulfilling her wish.!~

~!After losing three battles, her wish becomes tainted. She loses all memories of her friendship with Ruuko and Yuzuki, and WIXOSS. Hitoe becomes unable to make friends and receives painful shocks whenever someone with any kind of positive affections touches her.!~
Ulith is Iona's LRIG and black in color. She has a sadistic personality similar to Akira and enjoys mocking weaker opponents.
An elementary school girl who reads novels. She possesses the LRIG card, Eldora.
Chiyori's LRIG in Selector Infected WIXOSS.

Yuzuki's LRIG. Hanayo seems to have a calm and a composed personality. She supports Yuzuki in times of need, this is seen when she told Yuzuki that there was nothing wrong with her wish. Hanayo seemed to have some knowledge about Tama which is not yet revealed up to this point.
Mayu is the main antagonist of the selector infected WIXOSS series. She is a mysterious being who oversees the LRIGs and the Selector system and the creator of the selector battles.
Hatsu Kominato is Ruuko Kominato's grandmother.
Midoriko is the first LRIG of Hitoe.

Yuzuki's twin brother. He introduced Yuzuki to the game, and was the one to give her the deck containing Hanayo. Kazuki is one of the few non-Selectors to know about WIXOSS' secret.

He seems to be unaware of Yuzuki's feelings.
Ayumu Kominato is Ruuko Kominato's older brother. He gave Ruuko her WIXOSS deck.
